verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Settlement Report explicitly built for reconciling transactions to payouts, plus separate APIs for Balances, Chargebacks, and Refunds that would feed itemized breakdowns. However, the evidence never shows the settlement report's actual line-item schema (fee/refund/chargeback columns) or confirms it maps directly to bank deposit amounts. Missing for 10: an example of the itemized settlement report format, explicit fee-line breakdown, and independent/hands-on confirmation that finance-ops teams can fully reconcile bank deposits from it.
